intent: SCALE: very long labels - 10 nodes each carrying a ~600-character label (~6KB total, well under maxTextSize=50000). flowchart is configured htmlLabels:true, so tests whether the foreignObject wraps, overflows the node border, or clips. Long-label legibility is judged separately per theme.
